{{Quote|Wish I'd seen that sight a thousand times before.|An [[Unidentified rescue worker|anonymous rescue worker]] who witnessed the explosion|<ref name="THSE" />}}
A '''city surveillance droid''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Taris Siege|Siege of Taris]] in [[3963 BBY]]. During the siege, the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]] was not able to determine how to go about its duties in light of the battle, and it attempted to issue a parking ticket to what was in fact a live bomb planted by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in the planet's [[Middle City]]. The act caused the bomb to detonate, injuring nobody and amusing many beings nearby. The ''[[Taris Holofeed]]'' reported on the incident afterward.<ref name="THSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The surveillance droid is mentioned in the [[in-universe]] news organ ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]'', which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and included in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|fifteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series,<ref name="THSE" /> which was released on [[April 4]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-396/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-15|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #15}}</ref>
